1. It hits the right mirror at level A and turns downward.
2. Hits the bottom-right mirror and turns left.
3. Hits the bottom-middle mirror and turns upward.
4. Hits the middle mirror at level A and turns right.
5. Hits the right mirror at level A again and turns upward.
6. Hits the upper-right mirror and turns left.
7. Hits the upper-middle mirror and turns upward.
8. Hits the top-middle mirror and turns left.
9. Hits the top-left mirror and turns upward, exiting at the top at position E.

Thus the laser beam ends at:

\[
\boxed{\text{E}}
\]
